name: Full Body in Phases
description: Three full-body workouts, A, B and C, done in order three days a week for 12 weeks. The same exercises run through three 4-week phases, Build, Strength and Peak: each phase lifts heavier for fewer reps and rests longer between exercises. After the 12 weeks, the Peak phase repeats until you start another program.

phases.name: Build
phases.description: Moderate weights and higher reps to build muscle and practise the lifts

phases.name: Strength
phases.description: Heavier weights and fewer reps on the main lifts

phases.name: Peak
phases.description: Heavy sets of 3 to 5 on the main lifts, with longer rests
